suite.name: Cairn signup through first journey, v3.1 suite

files.cairn-account-use-cases-v32.json: Owns the account entity (including break fields), sign-in, sessions, setup acknowledgments, preferred name, voice, notification preferences, Settings, and account deletion.
files.cairn-case-creation-use-cases-v32.json: Owns cases, intake, journey selection, Start journey, the home screen, and action confirmations.
files.cairn-support-crisis-plan-v32.json: Owns crisis detection, care levels, care rest triggers and the trial pause, the follow-up check-in, and support resources. Wins on crisis behavior.
files.cairn-take-a-break-use-cases-v32.json: Owns the Take a break control, every break screen, Cairn's rest offers, what is sent or held during a break, the break-ending notice, and coming back.
files.cairn-subscription-use-cases-v33.json: Owns subscribing, Stripe checkout and events, renewal, failed payments, cancelling, and subscription notices.

suite.rule: Each decision and each field has exactly one owner file. Other files reference it by ID and do not restate it.

instructions_for_claude_code: This file owns the Take a break control and every break screen. Remove break behavior from components built from earlier specs and route it through the flows here.
Build the control once as a shared component and place it through the app layout, so a new view gets it by default. View inventory exceptions must be explicit.
Implement every acceptance criterion as an automated test. UC-BRK-01 is a test suite over the whole view inventory, run on every release.
Where this file and the crisis plan differ on crisis behavior, the crisis plan wins. Report the difference.
User-facing strings in copy are used verbatim and stored in the copy layer so they can be versioned after review.
Do not use em dashes in any user-facing copy.
changelog_v3_2: New BRK-D-08: a break never affects a paid subscription. Breaks are only for the user to step back and recover.
New copy.rest_subscription_note shown to subscribed users on the rest choices and break started screens at care level 1.
Subscribed users no longer see nothing about billing at level 1. They now see that their subscription keeps going as normal.
rest_care_clock_note and trial_clock_paused_at apply only while the free days are running.
Stripe failed-payment emails added as an exception to AC-BRK-06 (subscription SUB-D-08).

decisions.decision: The break control is labeled Take a break on every Cairn view, including the welcome screen and every account setup screen. I need a moment is retired.
For a break with an end time, Cairn sends one notice 24 hours before the break ends, through the user's notification channels (account notification_preferences). In-app shows it too.

decisions.topic: Break-ending notice during a care rest
decisions.decision: Not sent during a care rest (levels 2 to 4) by default. The crisis plan says Cairn returns to tasks only when the user asks and sends no nudges during a rest. Shown inside Cairn only.
Break screens after sign-in show the quiet 988 line and the Support resources link. Nothing is asked. Carries over account D-17 and crisis plan DEC-26-07.

After about 45 minutes of active use in one session, and after a heavy task or heavy question (for example a bank call, a certificate order, funeral research, or case UC-CASE-05). Offered at most once per session per trigger. Declining never brings it back in the same session.
decisions.status: Confirmed 2026-09-29 as crisis plan DEC-26-02. Moved here.

decisions.topic: A break covers the person, not one case
decisions.decision: A break is stored on the account and applies to every active journey. case.tasks_paused_until is set to the same value on each active case so existing code keeps working.
For the rest of today ends at 11:59 PM in the user's time zone. A few days ends 3 days after the break starts. A week ends 7 days after. Until I come back has no end time.

Taking a break never affects a paid subscription. It does not pause billing, move the renewal date, lower the price, extend the paid month, or earn a refund or credit. Breaks are only for the user to step back from the journey and recover. The only billing effect of any break is that a care rest pauses the free days, and only while the free days are still running.

decisions.not_shown: At care levels 2, 3, and 4 no billing wording appears (crisis plan). The rule still applies there.

data_requirements.note: Fields live on the account (owned by cairn-account-use-cases-v32.json). Listed here for reference.

account.break_until: timestamp, nullable. Null with break_started_at set means Until I come back.
account.break_notice_at: timestamp, nullable. break_until minus 24 hours, moved to the end of quiet hours if it falls inside them. Null when no notice is scheduled.
account.trial_clock_paused_at: existing, crisis plan DEC-26-01. Set only for a care rest.

case.tasks_paused_until: existing. Set to account.break_until on every active case (BRK-D-06).

privacy: No break type, reason, or care level is stored. A care rest is known only while trial_clock_paused_at is set, and that field is never shown to staff dashboards with a user id.
Whether a notice is scheduled is decided at break start and stored only as break_notice_at.

use_cases.title: Take a break is on every view and works the same way
preconditions: Build includes the shared Take a break component.
main_flow: For each view in view_inventory where take_a_break_visible is true, load the view in each context it can appear in.
Check the control is visible, labeled exactly copy.take_a_break_control, and in the same place on every view.
Select it with a pointer, with the keyboard (Tab then Enter or Space), and through a screen reader.
Check the screen that opens matches expected_screen for that view and context.
Select the screen's resume action and check the user returns to the same view with nothing lost.
acceptance_criteria: Present on 100 percent of the views marked visible, in every context listed, at every care level.
Not shown on break screens (V-41 to V-43, V-45). Each of those shows its replacement action instead.
One select, no confirmation dialog (crisis plan level 1).
Target at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels, which meets WCAG 2.2 target size minimum (2.5.8).
Visible without scrolling sideways at 320 CSS pixels wide and at 400 percent zoom (WCAG 2.2 reflow, 1.4.10).
Accessible name is Take a break. Focus order reaches it on every view. Visible focus indicator.
Does not rely on color. Has a text label, not only an icon.
Partly typed text in a field is kept when the user resumes.
Selecting it while the speech listener is on (V-29) stops listening and discards the audio before the break screen opens (case UC-CASE-22).
Selecting it on a delete confirmation (V-25, V-34) cancels the deletion. Nothing is deleted.
Every view added after this spec gets the control by default. A view without it fails the test unless listed in view_inventory with take_a_break_visible false.

use_cases.title: Take a break before signing in
preconditions: User is on V-01 to V-09, or on V-10 while signed out.
main_flow: Open S-01.
On Go back, return to the view the user came from.
acceptance_criteria: No account is created and no data is stored.
On V-03 (check your inbox), a magic link that is already sent stays valid for its normal 15 minutes.
Support resources link works without signing in (crisis plan AC-26-10).

use_cases.title: Take a break during account setup
preconditions: User is on V-11 to V-22, or on V-23 to V-25 with no case.
main_flow: Stop the setup flow and save progress (account onboarding_step).
Open S-02 during setup, or S-02b after setup with no case.
Acknowledge without steering back to setup. Wait with no timers, nudges, or reminders.
On copy.setup_break_resume, continue at the first incomplete step (account UC-REG-13).

alternate_flows.condition: Distress or harm language is present.
steps: Follow the crisis plan for that level (context account_setup). This includes the check-in offer (crisis plan DEC-26-04).
Progress is already saved. On next sign-in, account UC-REG-13 resumes.

acceptance_criteria: No trial fields change.
No notification is sent about a setup break.
copy.quiet_988_line and the Support resources link are on S-02 (BRK-D-04).
Behavior is identical across voices.

use_cases.title: Take a break on an active journey
use_cases.migrated_from: crisis plan rest section and DEC-26-07, UC-END-08
use_cases.actor: Signed-in user with an active journey
preconditions: At least one active journey. Care level 1.
use_cases.trigger: User selects Take a break, or accepts a rest offer (UC-BRK-06).
main_flow: Open S-04 with the four rest choices.
On the free days, show copy.rest_normal_clock_note with the trial end date. If subscribed, show copy.rest_subscription_note (BRK-D-08).
On a choice, set break_started_at and break_until (BRK-D-07) on the account and tasks_paused_until on every active case.
If break_until is more than 24 hours away, schedule break_notice_at (UC-BRK-09).
Make no change to the Stripe subscription or any subscription field.
Open S-05.

alternate_flows.condition: User selects Never mind, keep going.
steps: Return to the view they came from. Nothing changes.

alternate_flows.condition: User is at care level 2, 3, or 4.

acceptance_criteria: Exactly four choices, labeled per copy.
The trial clock keeps running for a normal rest and trial_ends_at does not change (AC-BRK-05).
S-05 names the end date in the user's time zone, or says it is open-ended.
copy.break_notice_line appears only when break_notice_at is set, and names the channels that will be used.
Subscribed users see copy.rest_subscription_note on S-04 and S-05 at level 1.
Starting, changing, or ending a break makes no Stripe API call and changes no subscription field (BRK-D-08).

use_cases.title: Cairn offers a break
use_cases.migrated_from: case UC-CASE-23 rest offer, crisis plan DEC-26-02
use_cases.trigger: About 45 minutes of active use in a session, or a heavy task or heavy question just finished (BRK-D-05).
main_flow: Show copy.offer_after_time or copy.offer_after_task. In a draft, add copy.offer_draft_suffix.
On yes: in a draft, UC-BRK-04. On an active journey, UC-BRK-05.
On no, or if the user keeps going, continue with no further mention.
acceptance_criteria: At most once per session per trigger.
Declining never brings the offer back in the same session.
Not shown at care levels 2 to 4. The crisis plan handles those.
Written at about grade 8 and announced to screen readers.

use_cases.title: Care rest (levels 2 to 4)
use_cases.actor: Signed-in user with an active journey
preconditions: Crisis plan sets care level 2, 3, or 4, or the user selects Take a break while at one of those levels.
use_cases.trigger: User chooses rest at level 2, Cairn pauses tasks at level 3 or 4, or the user selects Take a break at levels 2 to 4.
main_flow: At level 2, open S-04 and show copy.rest_care_clock_note once if the user is on a trial.
At levels 3 and 4, tasks pause automatically. Offer S-04 only when the user asks how long. Show no trial or billing wording.
If the free days are still running, set trial_clock_paused_at (crisis plan DEC-26-01). Set break fields and tasks_paused_until. Never touch the subscription.
Do not schedule a break-ending notice outside Cairn (BRK-D-03).
The crisis plan check-in offer (DEC-26-04) runs separately and is not affected.
acceptance_criteria: trial_ends_at moves later by exactly the care rest length (crisis plan AC-26-04).
[SAFETY] No trial or billing wording at levels 3 and 4 (crisis plan AC-26-03).
break_notice_at stays null unless OPEN-BRK-01 is decided otherwise.
For a subscribed user whose free days have ended, a care rest sets no trial field and changes nothing about billing (BRK-D-08).

use_cases.title: While the user is on a break
use_cases.actor: System, and the user if they open Cairn
main_flow: Hold every reminder outside Cairn: due dates, inactivity notices, and trial reminders. A trial reminder that falls during a normal rest shows only inside Cairn (account D-14).
A paid subscription keeps renewing and charging on its normal dates during every kind of break (BRK-D-08).

Still send: sign-in links the user asks for, confirmations of actions the user takes (case UC-CASE-21), an opted-in check-in (crisis plan DEC-26-04), the break-ending notice (UC-BRK-09), and Stripe's own billing emails, which are not held (subscription SUB-D-08).
If the user opens Cairn, show S-06 first.

steps: Sign out or stay on S-06. Nothing changes.

alternate_flows.condition: User wants to look at something without ending the break.
steps: Allow viewing cases and tasks. Editing a task ends the break and goes to UC-BRK-10 first.

acceptance_criteria: No message outside Cairn except the four listed (AC-BRK-06).
Opening Cairn during a break never asks the user to explain or to return.

use_cases.title: Break-ending notice 24 hours before
preconditions: A normal rest with break_until more than 24 hours after break_started_at (A few days, or A week).
main_flow: Send copy.break_ending_notice_subject and copy.break_ending_notice_body through each channel in account notification_preferences.channels: email to the sign-in email and a browser notification if browser is on.
Show the same message in Cairn the next time the user opens it.
Set break_notice_sent_at.

steps: Send at the end of quiet hours. This is still before the break ends.

alternate_flows.condition: The user ends or changes the break first.
steps: Cancel or reschedule the notice (UC-BRK-10, UC-BRK-11).

alternate_flows.condition: The user deletes the account, or deletes the last active case.
The break is a care rest.
For the rest of today, or Until I come back.
steps: No notice. The first is shorter than 24 hours, the second has no end.

acceptance_criteria: Sent exactly once per break, 24 hours before break_until, or at the end of quiet hours if that time is inside them.
Sent by every channel the user selected, and by no channel they did not select.
[PRIVACY] Notice text has no display name, circumstance, task detail, or crisis wording.
Never sent for a draft or setup break.
A browser notification is sent only if permission is still granted. If permission was revoked, browser is removed from channels (account notification_preferences rules).
open_decisions: OPEN-BRK-02: if the account frequency is No reminders, is the notice still sent outside Cairn? Default: yes, because it is about a break the user set. Confirm.

use_cases.title: Coming back from a break
trigger: break_until passes and the user opens Cairn
User edits a task during a break
main_flow: Clear break fields and tasks_paused_until. Cancel an unsent notice.
If trial_clock_paused_at is set, add the paused time to trial_ends_at and clear it (crisis plan DEC-26-01).
Open S-07: where the user left off in one line, and copy.trial_resumed_after_care_rest once if the free days were paused.
Offer one clear next action.

alternate_flows.condition: break_until passes while the user is away.
steps: Held reminders resume on their normal schedule. No catch-up burst of messages.

acceptance_criteria: Never asks the user to explain the gap.
Reminders held during the break are not all sent at once afterward.
Trial dates on S-07 are in the user's time zone.

use_cases.title: Change how long a break lasts
use_cases.trigger: User selects Change how long on S-06.
main_flow: Open S-04 with the current choice marked.
Recompute break_until from the original break_started_at for 3 and 7 days, or from now for the rest of today. Recompute or cancel break_notice_at.
Show S-05 with the new end.
acceptance_criteria: A changed break never sends two notices.

use_cases.title: Breaks and the 5-minute sign-out
preconditions: Account D-20: sign-out after 5 minutes with no activity.
main_flow: A break never stops or extends the session timeout.
Break state is saved on the account, so signing out never ends or changes a break.
After a timeout during a break, the next sign-in opens S-06.
acceptance_criteria: Break screens S-02 to S-06 show nothing from a case except the end date.
Being signed out during a break sends no message.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Take a break is on every view marked visible in view_inventory (UC-BRK-01).
[SAFETY] In account setup, selecting Take a break stops the flow, saves progress, and shows the 988 line.
[NOTICE] A normal rest longer than 24 hours sends exactly one break-ending notice 24 hours before it ends, by the selected channels.
[TRIAL] A normal-mode rest never changes trial_ends_at.

[REST] No message is sent outside Cairn while a break is active, except a sign-in link the user asks for, an action confirmation, an opted-in check-in, the break-ending notice, or Stripe's own billing emails (subscription SUB-D-08).
[REST] During any break, sign-in links the user requests and action confirmations are still delivered.
[SAFETY] No break-ending notice is sent outside Cairn during a care rest unless OPEN-BRK-01 decides otherwise.
[BILLING] No break of any kind changes a Stripe subscription, its renewal date, its price, or any subscription field in Cairn (BRK-D-08).
